Semantic conventions: `https://opentelemetry.io/schemas/1.40.0`.

## Span names

| Span name | Kind | Parent | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kenaz.chat.turn` | internal | none | One chat turn (the run of the agent loop for one user message) |
| `gen_ai.chat` | client | `kenaz.chat.turn` when the call runs inside a turn | One provider call, including every retry and fallback attempt |

`gen_ai.chat` is a fixed name on purpose: the semconv recommendation (`chat {model}`) is an unbounded name set an allowlist cannot declare. The model is in `gen_ai.request.model`.

No data travels in span events, links, tracestate or Status.Message: the spans set none of them (status is code-only).

## Attributes

Any key not listed here is never set. Content (prompts, completions, tool arguments, tool results, system prompt text) is never set, under any key.

| `gen_ai.operation.name` | string | one of: `chat` | `gen_ai.chat` | Always chat |
